extensionDescription.message: Schedule messages with recurring dates, delivery hours and weekday rules.

popupSubtitle.message: Your message, at the right time.

windowHint.message: End time is excluded. Overnight windows use the weekday of the actual send date.

deliveryNote.message: Thunderbird must be open and online. Late messages wait for the next permitted time.

snapshotNote.message: The message is saved in your account’s Drafts folder. Only this Thunderbird instance sends it.

duplicateRisk.message: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check your Sent folder and mail server before retrying. Retrying may send this message twice.

cancelDescription.message: Cancel all future sends and keep the message as an ordinary draft? Messages already sent cannot be recalled.

notificationReview.message: A scheduled draft needs your attention. Open Drafts to review it.

errorDate.message: Choose a valid local date and time. Times skipped by daylight saving are unavailable.

errorFuture.message: Choose a date and time in the future.

errorInterval.message: Enter a whole repeat interval between 1 and 10,000.

errorDelay.message: Enter a positive whole number of minutes.

errorWindow.message: Choose two different, valid start and end times.

errorTimeZone.message: The system time zone has changed. Reschedule this message to confirm a time in the new zone.

errorNoOccurrence.message: No delivery time is available for these rules.

errorStorage.message: The scheduled draft could not be saved. Check your connection, mail account storage and available disk space.

errorInterrupted.message: Thunderbird stopped during delivery. Check your Sent folder before retrying to avoid a duplicate.

errorMissingMessage.message: The scheduled draft is unavailable. Check your account’s Drafts folder.

errorDelivery.message: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check your Sent folder, connection and account settings before retrying.

errorSending.message: This message is already being sent. Wait for the delivery to finish.

errorAction.message: This action is no longer available. Refresh the queue.

errorConfirmRetry.message: Review the previous delivery and confirm before retrying.

errorCompose.message: Open this popup from a message’s compose window.

errorComposeBusy.message: This message is busy. Wait for the current operation to finish.

errorComposeClose.message: Your schedule was saved and paused because the compose window could not close. Open the queue to review it before resuming.

errorEncryption.message: Scheduling encrypted or digitally signed messages is not supported yet. Your message has not been scheduled or changed.

errorInlineImage.message: An embedded resource could not be saved. Attach it as a file or remove it before scheduling.

errorBlockedContent.message: Thunderbird has blocked an embedded resource. Review its blocked-content notice or remove the resource before scheduling.

errorTooLarge.message: The message and its attachments exceed the 50 MB scheduling limit.

errorRecipients.message: Add at least one valid recipient before scheduling.

errorIdentity.message: The sender account is unavailable. Check your Thunderbird account settings.

errorNewsgroups.message: Scheduling newsgroup posts is not supported.

errorSentCopy.message: The message was sent, but its Sent-folder copy could not be saved. Do not resend it.

errorOffline.message: The mail server is unavailable. Connect before saving a new schedule. Already scheduled messages will wait.

errorUnexpected.message: The operation could not be completed. Check the queue and try again.

errorDisconnected.message: The add-on was reloaded. Close and reopen this page to reconnect.

selectScheduledMessage.message: Select a highlighted scheduled message in your account’s Drafts folder.

inactiveMessage.message: This draft has no schedule on this Thunderbird instance.

folderNote.message: Editing a scheduled draft cancels its schedule. Schedule it again when your changes are ready.

errorQueueRemoved.message: This draft was edited, moved or deleted. Its schedule has been cancelled.

errorServerDrafts.message: Choose a Drafts folder on your IMAP account in Account Settings → Copies & Folders before scheduling. Local folders cannot synchronize your drafts.

errorDraftMigration.message: A previous schedule could not be moved to server Drafts. It is paused and its original contents are retained. Check your IMAP Drafts settings and connection, then reload the add-on.
